neighbours.label: a number or quantity word that sets up a count of things ("there are three stages", "a small amount of")
fire: The author argues there are three stages in the growth of any city.
Soon only a small amount of homeowners will be paying the levy.
Once the form is signed, two tasks are started: a review and an audit.
The sand of the whole beach was all of one color after the storm.
Experts say there are four reasons the bridge failed so quickly.
The lawyer claimed $400,000 had been paid to keep the deal quiet.
In the end, only a tiny number of voters turned out for the vote.
